name: soy
title: Start-of-year (SOY) budgets — future state
description: The recommended future state of SOY for client sign-off: a cycle overview with next actions by role, a setup wizard, an items workspace with a side panel, final decisions, transfers with reconciliation, close-out, and activity — played through one FY2028 cycle, with a “Show what’s changing” layer on every screen.

fields.item: project number + fund + account type (Expense) within one fiscal year’s SOY — the Gemini identity
fields.amounts: whole dollars, recorded per stage (ewb, pm, final), each with who, when and a rationale
fields.transfers: per item, tied to a Budget Decision (one per round); variance = final − transferred
fields.today: the demo date moves with the walkthrough (Jan 15 → Jun 15, 2027)

notes: Screens: /soy (overview), /soy/cycles, /soy/setup, /soy/items (+ item side panel on every screen), /soy/finals, /soy/transfers, /soy/close-out, /soy/activity.
State changes are plain functions in src/lib/soy/actions.ts; the store wraps each in persist + notify (event cbf-soy:change). Bulk actions return a report of written and skipped items.
Walkthrough presets (?step=1…7, plus 4.5 for the PM landing) compose the same actions; src/lib/soy/soy.test.ts pins their numbers (npm test).
Every behavior change is tagged UI / BE / DEC in src/lib/soy/changes.ts and annotated in place by the “Show what’s changing” layer (cbf-soy-changes).
All people and comment text are invented; project numbers and titles are illustrative.

sections.label: How to use it
sections.html:
This prototype shows the whole recommended future state of start-of-year (SOY) budgets — screens and behavior together — played through one FY2028 cycle with mock data shaped like FY2027 (about 240 items and $327M baseline). Nothing here changes CBFish; it’s for review and sign-off before anything is built.

How to use it
  • Start a step below: each link loads the demo data for that point in the year, so you can begin anywhere.
  • Viewing as switches between the budget administrator and a project manager (Casey Navarro).

guide.intent: Orients a client reviewer: what the prototype is, that it changes nothing in CBFish, and the four prototype devices — step links, the role lens, the “Show what’s changing” layer and reset/jump.
decisions: Prototype devices live in cbf-prototype-strip on every SOY screen so they never read as product.
acceptance: Every device named here exists in the prototype strip on /soy.

sections.label: Step cards
sections.html:
The FY2028 cycle, step by step

  1. 1. The FY2028 cycle drafts itself

    Demo date
    Jan 15, 2027
    Role
    Budget administrator
    • FY2028 appears in All cycles as Draft, with the standard dates.
    • FY2024–2027 are flagged as still open.
    Start at All cycles

  2. 2. Set up the cycle

    Demo date
    Jan 15, 2027
    Role
    Budget administrator
    • Confirm the pre-filled dates.
    • Carry forward 230 items; 7 ended or ineligible items start unchecked, each with its reason.
    Open the setup wizard

guide.intent: The FY2028 cycle as seven steps, each linking to the screen and loading the demo state for that moment (?step=N&role=…), so a reviewer can start anywhere.
decisions: Presets are built by running the same actions a presenter would click, so jumping and clicking always agree.
Step 4 has a second link (?step=4.5&role=pm) to the PM’s landing just after PM proposed opens.
acceptance: Step 2 → setup carries 230 of 237 items (7 unchecked with reasons) and adds 4 new projects.
Step 5 → the overview shows 4 PMs with 12 items outstanding and the automatic reminder sent.
Step 7 → the close-out checklist is all green with two transfer rounds.

sections.label: Decisions table
sections.html:
Decisions we need from you

The prototype shows our recommended option for each. Tell us if you prefer the alternative.

# Decision
DEC 1 Close FY2024–2027?
DEC 2 Should Complete lock admins?

guide.intent: The eight decisions BPA needs to make, with the option the prototype shows and the alternative, each linked to where it can be seen.
decisions: Built at build time from DECISIONS in src/lib/soy/changes.ts, the same registry the changes layer reads.
acceptance: 8 rows, DEC 1–8, each linking to a SOY screen.

sections.label: Problem map
sections.html:
What each change solves

42 changes in all: 28 need front-end work only (UI), 15 need backend or data work (BE), and 13 show a recommended answer to a decision (DEC). Turn on “Show what’s changing” on any screen to see them in place.

Problem today Answered on Changes
P1 The cycle is assembled by hand every year All cycles, Setup The next cycle drafts itself · One setup wizard · Dates are pre-filled
P2 Due dates do nothing Overview, Setup, Final decisions, Activity Stage tracker with due dates · Advance stage with an email preview · "Needs input" replaces Remaining · Dates are pre-filled · Notify PMs of final amounts · Automatic reminders

guide.intent: Each of today’s ten problems (P1–P10) with the screens and changes that answer it, plus counts of UI, BE and DEC changes so engineering can see the weight.
acceptance: Every problem P1–P10 lists at least one change.
